title: Queue
text: Enqueue messages and entities, 1 input, 6 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Queue type} sets the queue type; {Overwrite the oldest element if queue is full} sets the queue overwriting policy, {Capacity} sets the capacity of the queue, {Multicast tag} sets the tag when accepting entities broadcast via multicast sources, {Priority source} sets the which attribute of the entity determines its priority character, {Sorting direction} sets the direction of sorting based on priority, {Entity arrival source} sets the source of arrival for the entities Input, {Event action} sets the behavior of the entity in certain events, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities that have departed, {Number of entities in block, n} sets the outputs the number of entities present in the block, that are yet, {Average wait, w} sets the outputs the average wait time, {Average queue length, l} sets the outputs the average length of the entity and {Number of entities extracted, ex} sets the number of entities extracted from this. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Overwrite the oldest element if queue is full
params.values: Specify queue overwriting policy on (default for Simulink ® ) | off (default for SimEvents ® )

params.name: Capacity
params.values: Specify the capacity of the queue 25 (default) | scalar

params.name: Queue type
params.values: Choose the queue type FIFO (default) | LIFO | Priority

params.name: Multicast tag
params.values: Specify the tag when accepting entities broadcast via multicast sources A (default) | character vector

params.name: Priority source
params.values: Specify which attribute of the entity determines its priority character vector | entitySys.priority

params.name: Sorting direction
params.values: Choose the direction of sorting based on priority Ascending (default) | Descending

params.name: Entity arrival source
params.values: Choose the source of arrival for the entities Input port (default) | Multicast

params.name: Event action
params.values: Specify the behavior of the entity in certain events Entry (default) | Exit | Blocked

params.name: Number of entities departed, d
params.values: Outputs the number of entities that have departed the block off (default) | on

params.name: Number of entities in block, n
params.values: Outputs the number of entities present in the block, that are yet to depart off (default) | on

params.name: Average wait, w
params.values: Outputs the average wait time off (default) | on

params.name: Average queue length, l
params.values: Outputs the average length of the entity queue off (default) | on

params.name: Number of entities extracted, ex
params.values: Number of entities extracted from this block off (default) | on
